max_words_rationale: Restored to 380 in 2d. Book I, section 17 has a 420-word sentence that measured 523 model tokens, over bge-small-en-v1.5's 512-token input; it now splits at a semicolon. Every chunk is checked to be at most 512 model tokens before embedding.
split_strategy: Recursively choose the paragraph boundary closest to half the words; if none, the nearest sentence boundary; if none, the nearest point just after a semicolon followed by whitespace. Preserve order and paragraph breaks. Fail if a span with no paragraph, sentence or semicolon boundary exceeds max_words. No overlap.
